questions.q: Which type of tissue joins bone to bone and stabilises a joint?
questions.why: Ligaments join bone to bone; tendons join muscle to bone.

questions.q: Which pair of joints are both hinge joints?
questions.why: The elbow and knee only flex and extend; shoulder and hip are ball and socket.

questions.q: A swimmer raises her arms sideways away from her body. What is this movement?
questions.why: Abduction is movement away from the midline of the body.

questions.q: Explain the functions of synovial fluid and cartilage in a synovial joint.
questions.model: Synovial fluid lubricates the joint so the bones move smoothly with less friction. Cartilage covers the ends of the bones, reducing friction and absorbing shock.
points: Synovial fluid lubricates the joint / reduces friction
Cartilage covers bone ends and absorbs shock / prevents bone wear
